tinhNang.mo_ta_en: Camera finds the person facing you (±25°) and watches their mouth; AI separates their voice and shows captions on LilyGo T-Glass.
Four mics hear 360°, AI removes background noise but keeps meaningful sounds, played through the in-ear speaker.
TinyML recognises horns and alarms, DOA estimates the direction, a motor buzzes left, right or behind; the glasses show an arrow.
